# Map Shows Trump’s Approval Rating in Every State 2 Months Until Midterms

Published

Sep 03, 2026 at 05:00 AM EDT

updated

Sep 03, 2026 at 12:34 PM EDT

Sam Stevenson

Associate News Editor

With two months to go until Americans vote in the 2026 midterm elections, new polling shows President Donald Trump facing a political landscape that has deteriorated significantly since the start of his second term.

The data comes from Civiqs' rolling online tracking poll of registered voters. [...] A Newsweek analysis compares Trump's approval rating on August 31, 2026, with where it stood when he returned to office on January 20, 2025, with net approval calculated as approve minus disapprove.

According to Civiqs, last updated August 12, Trump's net approval in New Jersey stood at -35%.

New Jersey tilts unfavorable overall. About 65% of New Jersey residents polled currently disapprove of the president's performance.About 30% approve and another 5% did not choose either.

Education: Respondents across all education levels disapprove of Trump’s job performance, with postgraduate at 78%, college graduate at 67% and non-college graduate at 60%. [...] Party: Democrats were most unfavorable toward Trump, with 98% disapproving, followed by independents at 62% disapproval. Meanwhile, Republicans were the most favorable toward Trump, with 82% approving of Trump's job performance.
